title: another aussie - bali holiday
style: Upbeat Bali tropical world fusion, authentic Balinese gamelan metallophones and jegog bamboo xylophones, driving kendang drums, melodic suling bamboo flute, bright ceng-ceng cymbals, angklung rattles, modern pop production with Aussie comedy storytelling, multi-vocal family ensemble (6 layers), distinct characters for each singer, fun energetic holiday vibe, local culture showcase, Suno showcase of traditional Balinese instruments blended with contemporary grooves, [Uplifting], [Tropical], [World Music Fusion], [Energetic], [Playful]√
lyrics:
[Intro - Light suling flute + soft gamelan, family arriving excitement]
Selamat pagi Bali! Scooters buzzing, smiles all around
Aussie family touchdown, "G'day mate, we're on holiday ground!"
No worries, she'll be right — fair dinkum, here we go
Culture tour loading, every moment stealing the show

[Verse 1 - Corey - happy smart lead, clear baritone]
Happy smart Corey with the plan in his pocket, spreadsheet king
"Righto crew, jungle villa sorted, no last-minute thing"
Monkeys eyeing the luggage, "Corey you legend, you absolute ripper!"
Keeping us laughing while the culture hits us quicker

[Pre-Chorus - Michelle + Ruby warm harmonies]
Mishy Mish Mash already scouting the closest court at dawn
"Pickleball in paradise? Mate, the game goes on!"

[Chorus 1 - Full family, upbeat gamelan swell + group vocals]
Aussie Bali Holiday — fresh flavours, no repeat
Street food belly full, local rhythms at our feet
Plait your hair? Dollar dollar, haggle with a cheeky grin
Ruby teaching Wezza swim — "I got this Da da, watch him win!"
Art is everywhere, animals welcome in the frame
Bali instruments dancing, family voices doing the same

[Verse 2 - Michelle - bright coach energy, 5am market vibe]
5am fresh at the pasar, Michelle the pickleball queen
Baskets overflowing, spices dancing, what a scene
"Bali style brekkie for me — nasi goreng, bubur too
Local flavours everywhere, mate, I'm making dreams come true!"
Off to the warung court, "Mishy Mish Mash on the prowl"
Explaining pickleball to locals — "It's tennis but smaller, no foul!"

[Post-Chorus - Ruby & Wesley playful call-response]
Roo Roo sketching monkeys, "Let the animals in!"
Wezza gaming poolside, "High score in the jungle din!"

[Verse 3 - Ruby - bright artistic kid, stylist flair]
Roo Roo the stylist artist, sketchbook glued to her side
"My art stays with me, everywhere the colours hide"
Temple carvings, offerings, "Look Mum, it's living art!"
Plaiting hair at the salon, "Bali queen from the start!"
Let the monkeys pose for portraits, "They're part of the crew"
Every corner a canvas — Ruby's Bali breakthrough

[Verse 4 - Wesley - cheeky gamer kid rap-sung, energetic]
Wez the Wezza, gamer pro with the joystick tan from the plane
"Ruby, teach me swim quick? B b B, no pain no gain!"
"I got this Da da! Watch Wezza go — splash, dive, win the race!"
Underwater gamer mode, no lag in this tropical place
"Ruby Roo Roo you're the best, but I'm the swim champ now!"
Laughing till the geckos join — "Wez for the win, bow wow!"

[Bridge - Group comedy, street food + bargaining + jungle]
Bali street food belly — sate sticks, babi guling, mie goreng overload
"Dollar dollar dollar!" bargaining hard till the vendors explode
"Berapa? Murah lah mate!" Aussie slang meets local price fight
Jungle stay at night, frogs croaking, geckos in the light
Corey smart planner, Mish coach on the court
Roo Roo creating, Wezza gaming — this family's the sort

[Chorus 2 - Bigger, evolved, more instruments showcased]
Aussie Bali Holiday — culture licks, fresh and true
No repeating the same old lines, every moment new
Gamelan metallophones ring, kendang drums keep the beat
Suling flute melodies float while our family voices meet
Plait your hair? Dollar dollar, we haggled like pros
Ruby taught the swim lesson, Wezza stole the show
Michelle's 5am market magic, Corey's happy smart core
Bali jungle stay forever — we couldn't ask for more

[Outro - Fading suling + full family harmonies + light ceng-ceng]
No worries Bali... terima kasih for the ride
Aussie family holiday, sealed with local pride
Selamat jalan till next time — we'll be back for sure
6 voices strong, instruments singing, culture rich and pure
Aussie Bali Holiday... she'll be right, mate — encore!
